stem: An application record shows a product was used correctly last season, but the product label has since been revised. Which instruction governs a new application?
choices: The current legally applicable label and current site requirements should be verified for the new application
The prior-season record permanently authorizes the old directions
The oldest label should be used for consistency
Whichever version permits the shortest interval should be selected
rationale: Historical records document past actions; they do not replace verification of the current label and current applicable requirements for a new decision.
